name: com.aitherium/aitheros
title: AitherOS
description: AitherOS platform MCP: agents, code, memory and infrastructure tools over one endpoint

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key minted by the Aitherium signup endpoint (aither_sk_live_*). OAuth2 clients send the same bearer.

environmentVariables.name: AITHERIDENTITY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the AitherIdentity endpoint used for sign-in. Only needed for a self-hosted node; the public default works out of the box.

environmentVariables.name: AITHERIUM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for the hosted gateway. The local runtime runs fully local without it; its file and web tools need no credential.
